# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite, async readback, and Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and upgrades to Skia milestone m152. This release adds Vulkan/Metal/Dawn Graphite bindings, backend-neutral async pixel readback, a new Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and Nano Server font support via FreeType. It also fixes several native memory-safety bugs and ships a batch of managed-code performance improvements.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m152** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from Chrome milestone m152, and several upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes were merged before the upgrade. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — SkiaSharp now exposes Skia's next-generation Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for Vulkan interop via Silk.NET. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels, an async, backend-neutral API for reading back pixels without blocking the calling thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — Text rendering on Windows Nano Server containers now uses FreeType for font loading, enabling SkiaSharp to run in minimal container images that lack the usual Windows font stack. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes in SKRegion and SKPixmap** — SKRegion.SpanIterator no longer leaves a dangling native pointer after its owning SKRegion is collected, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* now root their source pixel buffer to prevent a use-after-free. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create failure path** — A native memory leak that occurred when SKImage.Create failed to create a raster image from a pixel buffer has been fixed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed-code performance improvements across several hot paths** — HandleDictionary's skip-registration reflection check is now cached, GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on its null-terminated path, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map, and SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new package adds Vulkan interop bindings built on Silk.NET, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Deterministic binding generation across platforms** — The generated P/Invoke bindings are now produced deterministically regardless of the host platform used to build them. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release with no API changes; the touched PRs were solution-format and CI infrastructure work.
